# What should yourAI influencer look like?

Design their permanent look — the face, body and hair that stay consistent in every photo and video. Outfits, poses and scenes are chosen later, shot by shot.

Every trait is optional. Anything left on Best Fit is picked by the AI to match the rest of your choices.

summary: The content describes a tool for designing a personalized AI influencer with customizable traits. Users can choose the influencer's permanent look, including gender, age, body type, ethnicity, eye color, hair characteristics, and distinctive details. The platform highlights that all traits are optional, with defaults set to 'Best Fit' that auto-select attributes based on user choices. Users can also generate a preview of their customized influencer after selecting the desired traits.
